tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Canvas under the paint.

tokens.name: glow-1
tokens.usage: Night glass: the attention light. It shines only through a card that needs you. Tunable hue.

tokens.name: glow-2
tokens.usage: Night glass: room light, bottom right, faint. Glass: violet light left. Night: teal glow.

tokens.name: glow-3
tokens.usage: Night glass: room light, top left; what the frost blurs. Glass: cyan light.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Widget fill. Night glass draws it at the tint knob's alpha (55% default, 35% minimum), over a blur.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised row, avatars, keys.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Widget border.

tokens.name: edge-hi
tokens.usage: The lit top edge: the one light falls from above.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Recessed field: keyboard, pressed state.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Ring and toggle track.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text. Night glass: 5.0:1 at worst (thinnest frost, over the lit card).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one primary action per screen: the mic, a primary button. Night glass keeps it white, so colour is left for attention.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Now and live: the current event, listening.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: All up.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Needs a look: low readiness, a calendar clash.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Broken: a failed deploy, a voice error.

groups.name: Night glass
groups.note: Inter only, as in Glass. Tabular figures everywhere; the clock at weight 200. Icon stroke equals the 15 px title stem (about 1.6 px), and an icon is as tall as the line it sits on.

styles.name: ng-title
styles.usage: Row titles; 20 px icons beside them.

styles.name: ng-body
styles.usage: Secondary lines; 16 px icons beside them.

groups.name: Glass
groups.note: Inter throughout; the clock at weight 200 with tight tracking.

groups.name: Night glow
groups.note: Geist for words, Geist Mono for every number and label.

styles.name: night-clock
styles.usage: Home clock; ink fading to teal.

spacing.note: One 4 px grid. Night glass: screen gutter 16, gap between cards 10 (density knob: 8–14), card padding 12 so inner radius = 28 − 12 = 16.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label to value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between two targets; two-up gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside a card; makes the inner radius concentric.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups on a drawer.

tokens.name: radius-phone
tokens.usage: Pixel 8a display corner.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Night glass card = half the 56 px search bar and app tile, so bar, tiles and cards share one curve.

tokens.name: radius-row
tokens.usage: A row inside a card: 28 − 12 padding, concentric.

tokens.name: radius-small
tokens.usage: Keys, album art corners.

tokens.name: radius-w-glass
tokens.usage: Glass widget.

tokens.name: radius-w-night
tokens.usage: Night widget.

tokens.name: size-target
tokens.usage: Every hit area.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: App tile in the dock and drawer; a circle.

tokens.name: size-search
tokens.usage: Search bar height; the mic inside is 48.

tokens.name: size-glyph
tokens.usage: Icon beside 15/20 text; 16 px beside 13/16 text.

tokens.name: stroke-glyph
tokens.usage: Icon stroke = text stem. Tunable 1.25 / 1.6 / 2; never scales with icon size.
